title: Artifact for: Overconstrainedness
description:
Code and measurement scripts for the TDK paper Overconstrainedness (Gábor Koncz, BME VIK, 2026). The paper asks how far the public data of a Halo2 circuit narrows down its private inputs, and whether those inputs can be recovered in practice.

This is a fork of quantstamp/halo2-analyzer (Korrekt), Quantstamp's MIT-licensed analyzer with contributions by Fatemeh Heidari, Jeffrey Kam, Jan Gorzny, mr-ma, Mohammad Jahanara and sorawee. It branches at upstream commit c201ed37b9daeab1c2289b57da13d097c009908f (2026-01-28). The upstream analyzer extracts Halo2 circuits, encodes their constraints as finite-field SMT formulas and checks them with cvc5. This fork adds the module korrekt/src/circuit_analyzer/ucp/: uniqueness constraint propagation (UCP) over an expression-tree view of the circuit, value and domain inference, bounded private-value recovery with SMT refinement, domain discovery and independent validation, the invoice and settlement examples of the paper, and the measurement harnesses behind the README's results map.
